title: Starship Poised to Make History on Next Launch as Flight 14 Approaches
detail: SpaceX Starship is positioned to make history on its next flight as preparations for Flight 14 continue at Starbase, Boca Chica. Live coverage is set for the upcoming mission, which represents the program's first full orbital insertion attempt. Super Heavy booster B21 rolled out to the launch mount in late September as SpaceX targets a launch no earlier than September 28.
